summary: Amesite Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an at-the-market offering of up to $2,266,112 in common stock under an agreement with H.C. Wainwright. Shares will be sold at prevailing market prices with a 3.0% agent commission. No fixed-price terms, premium, or board recommendation is present. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special-situation event. What to watch: dilution impact on existing shareholders given a public float of ~$9.8M and the one-third limitation under General Instruction I.B.6.
